info.name: For After API
info.description:
Positive and negative (NEG) tests for every implemented For After API route.

Run the whole collection in order with the Collection Runner: requests save ids into collection variables that later requests use. Auth is a session cookie (for_after_session) that Postman keeps automatically after login.

Select the "For After - Local" environment first.

item.name: 00 Health & Setup
item.description: No session needed. The first logout clears any cookie left from a previous run.

item.name: 01 Unauthenticated (401)
item.description: Every protected route without a session cookie must return 401.

item.name: NEG - GET message media without session
